classes.summary: HPXPrinterDetails is an Android UI automation page class for HP printer details screen. It extends SmartFlow and provides comprehensive methods for interacting with printer functionality tiles (scan, print, copy, fax, shortcuts, etc.). Key patterns include: 1) Swipe-to-find pattern with configurable max_swipes for locating elements in scrollable views, 2) Consistent timeout and raise_e parameters for flexible error handling, 3) Verification methods for UI element presence, 4) Data extraction methods for product information, 5) Navigation methods for printer information and reports, 6) Fallback mechanism using coordinate-based clicks when element location fails. The class uses string-based locator identifiers passed to a driver object, following the Page Object Model pattern for mobile test automation.
